Thanks Sofia — helpful recap. Looping in a couple notes from procurement/legal side: 

- Procurement status: We generally prefer PO for third-party vendors, but for platform/infra purchases we can do marketplace purchases to avoid full vendor onboarding.
- Current blocker: vendor onboarding queue in Coupa. We require: vendor registration form, vendor W-9 (or local equivalent), and a cybersecurity questionnaire returned before we can sign a PO. Our vendor ops team expects ~7–10 business days once the packet is complete.
- Legal: Data Processing Addendum is required; our counsel will review any standard DPA (we can share redlines).

Attachments: vendor-registration-form.pdf (please fill and return).

Quick asks: can you (1) confirm Redwood's DPA template or point to where it is, and (2) if marketplace is chosen, confirm whether Redwood is (or can be) listed on AWS Marketplace or GCP Marketplace — procurement likes marketplace because our purchasing card process is automated there.

Our current internal timeline: aim to complete vendor paperwork by Dec 15 so procurement can issue a PO before year-end. If marketplace is available, that could accelerate us into procurement approval by ~1 week.

Cheers,
Priya Singh
